answer: Make each new agent post a bonded deposit locked like a basalt anchor on the seafloor: honest work slowly earns it back, but any identity caught colluding is slashed and its bond burned. To spin up a sybil swarm, an attacker must fund an ocean of deposits upfront, and because vouchers forfeit their own stake when they endorse a fraud, the only credible signal is trustworthy capital genuinely at risk, which cannot be faked by cloning cheap keys.
